podcast.body: Bad Wolves' 2018 cover of The Cranberries' 1994 Modern Rock number one hit, "Zombie." This powerful cover was specifically recorded in memory of The Cranberries' lead singer, Dolores O'Riordan, following her passing. "Bad Wolves 2018 cover of the cranberries 1994 Modern Rock number one, Zambi, recorded in memory of cranberries lead singer Dolores Orrard."

podcast.body: This version was recorded in November 2017, featuring a slightly heavier sound than the original and minor lyrical changes, notably a reference to drones. Dolores O'Riordan approved of their rendition and offered to contribute to the final version, but tragically died the day before the scheduled studio session. The band released it, promising all profits to O'Riordan's three children, with the first check amounting to $250,000. "The first check was for $250,000."
